audit.whatIsWrong: The last three chart rows contradicted the packet, the 48.17% win rate, whys[6] and the already-audited mirror: level 6 was given to Gangplank while first item and 2+ items were given to Illaoi even though whys[6] says the lane flips to Gangplank.
audit.why: Gangplank scales; Illaoi's window is levels 2 through first item. The mirror page now reads Skill / Skill / Gangplank for those rows.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill 5/10, First item -> Skill 5/10, 2+ items -> Gangplank 4/10 (inverse of the mirror's 6/10), proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and level-6 phases gave no reason tied to Gangplank's own timing.
audit.why: Illaoi's Iceborn Gauntlet spike lands at roughly the moment Gangplank can start holding three kegs; Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 while Cannon Barrage is 160s but global.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why now name the 120s ultimate and the three-keg threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown line told the player to 'track Powder Kegs' and engage 'when it is down'. Powder Keg's cooldown is 0 in the kit file — there is no such window, so the whole framing was unactionable.
audit.why: The real punishable cooldown is Remove Scurvy (W), 22/20/18/16/14s, which both heals and cures crowd control. Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so resistances are the wrong response.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, dosFull[0].d and the Key Ability Interactions report now name Remove Scurvy's 22s and its cleanse-plus-heal, and the true-damage/global nature of Cannon Barrage is written into the late-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing despite Remove Scurvy plus Illaoi's own passive healing.
audit.why: Missing-interactions file: Gangplank sustains through chip damage, so anti-heal decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to the itemization line, ahead of Sterak's Gage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage's global range (30000) never mentioned as a map-wide threat.
audit.why: Being alive at low HP anywhere is a decision while his R is up, not a default.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[3] and the late text.

edits.before: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and grounds; Cannon Barrage's true damage answers it, so 6 is even — spend R only on a kill.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet arrives as his kegs do — force the fight when it completes, before he chains three.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items and the lane is his: chained kegs zone your tentacle field, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage your armour cannot answer.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy (W): 22s at rank 1, cures CC and heals — bait it, then commit, and buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s. - Test of Spirit (E): 16s. - Leap of Faith: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Kegs never go on cooldown — time trades on his 22s Remove Scurvy.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Powder Keg's cooldown is 0, so there is no keg window — the real one is Remove Scurvy: 22s, heals and cures CC.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Grievous Wounds for Remove Scurvy and Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps.

edits.before: Level 6 R tentacle wall plus E-Spirit out-damages his pre-cluster burst.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: your R slam trades with his global Cannon Barrage.

edits.before: First item stays yours while you deny full keg setups.
edits.after: First item is even — you deny kegs, he starts chaining.

edits.before: GP takes over once barrels are online — chained kegs detonate for huge burst and slow, letting him zone your tentacles, kite your E, and R Cannon Barrage to disengage every commit.
edits.after: GP takes over once barrels are online — chained kegs zone your tentacles and slow you off them, and Cannon Barrage is global true damage, so surviving at low HP anywhere on the map is a choice.

edits.before: Gangplank flips it late. Fully-online barrel chains detonate for massive burst and slow, letting him zone your tentacle field, kite your E, and R Cannon Barrage away from your commits.
edits.after: Gangplank flips it late. Barrel chains burst and slow you off your tentacle field, and Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores armour — never sit low HP in a side lane while his R is up.

notes: The biggest error on this page: it repeated 'track Powder Kegs, engage when it is down' in six places, but Powder Keg has a 0-second cooldown — there is no window to track. Retargeted onto Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1, heals and cures CC), which is the genuine punish window. Also: Cannon Barrage is true damage, so the Plated Steelcaps/armour framing does not help against it.
